## Complete smooth classification with credited prior obstruction

For every n >= 1, exactly the all-real-spectrum Segre/Jordan types occur on a
nonempty open subset of R^n for a smooth compactly supported real Nijenhuis
(1,1)-tensor. The construction permits arbitrary prescribed numerical real
eigenvalues, multiplicities, equality patterns and Jordan block sizes. Type
changes away from the realization domain are allowed.

The full analytic proof includes the torus-collar torsion identity, finite
ordered arrow deletion and scalar drift for every Jordan block, smooth
endpoint plateaus, same-dimensional torus embedding and exact zero extension.
The independent written audit and acceptance accompany the proof. Aggregate
finite checks are supporting metadata; no computational extrapolation or
omitted executable is a premise of the general theorem.

Necessity is credited to Bolsinov–Konyaev–Matveev, Nijenhuis Geometry,
Theorem 6.1: https://arxiv.org/abs/1903.04603v2 . The real semisimple and
two-dimensional Jordan cases were already credited by the original problem
source. The exact primary locator is Problem 5.11, PDF page 29, in
https://arxiv.org/abs/1804.03737v2 ; the earlier v1 is Problem 4.10, PDF page 37.
The corpus label 5.9 is not substituted for either primary locator.

## Distribution and review limits

Exactly eight authored proof/audit/acceptance/status and public-source-review
or metadata files are added under `unsolved_math_prioritization/attempts/2100509/`.
All mathematical statements, arguments, examples and qualifications are
preserved. Editorial changes remove private workflow/revision provenance,
replace unavailable script references with permitted aggregate metadata,
state review limits and bind the public proof and audit exactly.

This AI-assisted, unrefereed edition claims no bibliographic priority,
exhaustive preexisting-current-openness certificate, external human peer
review, journal acceptance or formal proof-assistant certification. Programs,
raw generated outputs, datasets, copied third-party source bodies or images,
and private coordination material are excluded. Recorded scholarly inspection
history is not a new retrieval, source rehash, inspection or literature search
by edition preparation.

QUEUE.md and unrelated entries remain unchanged. Editorial preparation adds
no substantive proof turn and resets no historical accounting. No merge,
release, DOI or outside outreach is requested.

Base commit: `f6caddda8f8be2cdb3e91494325d8f7f365bc3fc`.
